ENTRY: hasFilingCode - no check in this chunk; called with filingCode (FilingCodes); returns boolean.

ENTRY: buildCorrectionFiling - no check in this chunk; called with correctedFiling (any object) and correctionType (CorrectionTypes); returns CorrectionFilingIF.

ENTRY: buildRestorationFiling - no check in this chunk; called with restorationType (FilingSubTypes); returns RestorationFilingIF.

RULE: updateFilingData removes existing filingCode before conditionally re-adding it -> filingCode filter removes all with matching filingTypeCode, then if action === 'add' pushes new entry.

RULE: updateFilingData with undefined filingCode applies priority/waiveFees to all codes -> if priority !== undefined set element.priority to (action === 'add'), if waiveFees !== undefined set element.waiveFees to (action === 'add').

RULE: buildDissolutionFiling switches on getLegalType: if CorpTypeCd.SOLE_PROP or CorpTypeCd.PARTNERSHIP -> custodialOffice is getBusinessAddress or null; else custodialOffice is getRegisteredOfficeAddress.

STATES: buildCorrectionFiling sets correction.comment to empty string ''.

STATES: buildDissolutionFiling sets dissolutionType to FilingSubTypes.DISSOLUTION_VOLUNTARY.

ENTRY: mounted() - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: beforeDestroy() - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: fetchDraftFiling() - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: officeModifiedEventHandler(modified: boolean) - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: directorsPaidChange(modified: boolean) - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: directorsFreeChange(modified: boolean) - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: onAgmDateChange(val: string) - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: onAgmExtensionChange(val: boolean) - no check in this chunk

ENTRY: onClickSave() - no check in this chunk

RULE: if (!this.getIdentifier || isNaN(this.ARFilingYear) || isNaN(this.filingId)) -> goToDashboard(true), return. mounted()
RULE: if (this.isEntityCoop && (!this.arMinDate || !this.arMaxDate)) -> goToDashboard(true), return. mounted()
RULE: if (this.isBaseCompany && !this.nextARDate) -> goToDashboard(true), return. mounted()
RULE: if (this.filingId > 0) -> resume draft filing path: loadingMessage set, fetchDraftFiling() called, getOrigAddresses/getOrigDirectors fetched conditionally. mounted()
RULE: if (this.filingId <= 0) -> new filing path: loadingMessage set, getOrigAddresses/getOrigDirectors fetched. mounted()
RULE: if (!this.isVitestRunning) -> fetch original addresses and directors. mounted()
RULE: if (this.isBaseCompany) -> updateFilingData add FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_BC. mounted()
RULE: if (!filing) -> throw Error('Missing filing'). fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (!header) -> throw Error('Missing header'). fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (!business) -> throw Error('Missing business'). fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (!annualReport) -> throw Error('Missing annual report'). fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (header.name !== FilingTypes.ANNUAL_REPORT) -> throw Error('Invalid filing type'). fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (header.status !== FilingStatus.DRAFT) -> throw Error('Invalid filing status'). fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (business.identifier !== this.getIdentifier) -> throw Error('Invalid business identifier'). fetchDraftFiling()

RULE: if (header.routingSlipNumber) -> staffPaymentData.option = StaffPaymentOptions.FAS, set routingSlipNumber, isPriority. fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: else if (header.bcolAccountNumber) -> staffPaymentData.option = StaffPaymentOptions.BCOL, set bcolAccountNumber, datNumber, folioNumber, isPriority. fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: else if (header.waiveFees) -> staffPaymentData.option = StaffPaymentOptions.NO_FEE. fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: else -> staffPaymentData.option = StaffPaymentOptions.NONE. fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (this.isEntityCoop) -> newAgmDate and newNoAgm restored from annualReport. fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (changeOfDirectors exists && changeOfDirectors.directors?.length > 0) -> updatedDirectors set. fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (changeOfDirectors exists && changeOfDirectors.directors?.length === 0) -> throw Error('Invalid change of directors object'). fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (changeOfAddress exists && this.isBaseCompany && registeredOffice && recordsOffice) -> updatedAddresses set, updateFilingData add FilingCodes.ADDRESS_CHANGE_OT. fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (changeOfAddress exists && !this.isBaseCompany && registeredOffice) -> updatedAddresses set, updateFilingData add FilingCodes.ADDRESS_CHANGE_OT. fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (changeOfAddress exists && conditions not met) -> throw Error('Invalid change of address object'). fetchDraftFiling()
RULE: if (modified && this.dataLoaded) -> updateFilingData add FilingCodes.ADDRESS_CHANGE_OT. officeModifiedEventHandler()
RULE: if (!modified && this.dataLoaded) -> updateFilingData remove FilingCodes.ADDRESS_CHANGE_OT. officeModifiedEventHandler()
RULE: if (modified && this.dataLoaded) -> updateFilingData add FilingCodes.DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT. directorsPaidChange()
RULE: if (!modified && this.dataLoaded) -> updateFilingData remove FilingCodes.DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT. directorsPaidChange()
RULE: if (modified && this.dataLoaded) -> updateFilingData add FilingCodes.FREE_DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT. directorsFreeChange()
RULE: if (!modified && this.dataLoaded) -> updateFilingData remove FilingCodes.FREE_DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT. directorsFreeChange()
RULE: if (val && this.dataLoaded) -> updateFilingData add FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_OT. onAgmDateValidChange()
RULE: if (!val && this.dataLoaded) -> updateFilingData remove FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_OT. onAgmDateValidChange()

ORDER: fetchDraftFiling() fetches and throws on validation failure; on success restores certifiedBy, staffPaymentData, AGM data, changeOfDirectors, changeOfAddress; later updateFilingData calls add filing codes. mounted() and onClickSave() depend on this order.

ON ERROR: fetchDraftFiling().catch(error) -> resumeErrorDialog = true, error logged to console. fetchDraftFiling() throws propagate to caller.

CALLS OUT: LegalServices.fetchFiling(url: `businesses/${this.getIdentifier}/filings/${this.filingId}`) - no credential shown in chunk - returns filing object with header, business, annualReport, changeOfDirectors, changeOfAddress.

CALLS OUT: this.$refs.directorsComponent.getOrigDirectors(this.asOfDate, isEmpty(this.updatedDirectors)) - target component method.

STATES: this.nextARDate (required if this.isBaseCompany)

STATES: this.newAgmDate (restored for coop, empty string default)
STATES: this.newNoAgm (restored for coop, false default)

STATES: this.updatedAddresses (restored or left intact)

34651.text:
Manages business filing save workflows with three user-initiated paths (Save, Save and Resume, File and Pay), handling draft/final filing persistence, payment routing, and error recovery.

ENTRY: `onClickSaveFinish()` - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: `onClickSaveResume()` - checks `this.busySaving` to prevent double saving
ENTRY: `onClickSaveResumeFinish()` - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: `onClickFilePay(fromStaffPayment = false)` - checks `this.busySaving` to prevent double saving; if `this.isRoleStaff && !fromStaffPayment` -> detours to staff payment dialog
ENTRY: `onClickFilePayFinish()` - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: `saveFiling(isDraft)` - no check in this chunk
ENTRY: `goToDashboard(force = false)` - checks `!this.haveChanges || force` to proceed

RULE: in `onClickSaveFinish()`: if `this.filingId > 0` -> sets `this.haveChanges = false`; else logs to console
RULE: in `onClickSaveResumeFinish()`: if `this.filingId > 0` -> sets `this.haveChanges = false` and calls `this.goToDashboard(true)`; else logs to console
RULE: in `onClickFilePay()`: if `error?.response?.status === StatusCodes.PAYMENT_REQUIRED` -> sets `this.haveChanges = false`, sets `this.paymentErrorDialog = true`, returns filing; else if other error -> sets `this.saveErrorReason = SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY`, returns filing
RULE: in `onClickFilePayFinish()`: if `this.filingId > 0` -> sets `this.haveChanges = false`; if `this.savedFiling.header.isPaymentActionRequired` -> navigates to payment URL; else navigates to dashboard; else logs to console
RULE: in `saveFiling()`: if `this.filingId === 0` and `hasPendingTasks` -> sets error and throws; switch on `this.staffPaymentData.option` sets header fields: if `StaffPaymentOptions.FAS` -> sets `routingSlipNumber`, `priority`; if `StaffPaymentOptions.BCOL` -> sets `bcolAccountNumber`, `datNumber`, `folioNumber`, `priority`; if `StaffPaymentOptions.NO_FEE` -> sets `waiveFees = true`
RULE: in `saveFiling()`: if `this.isEntityCoop` -> includes `annualReport` with `agmExtension: (!this.noAgm && this.agmExtension) || false`, `didNotHoldAgm: this.noAgm || false`; if `this.isBaseCompany` -> includes `annualReport` with different structure
RULE: in `saveFiling()`: if filing code includes `FilingCodes.DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT` or `FilingCodes.FREE_DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT` -> includes `changeOfDirectors`
RULE: in `saveFiling()`: if filing code includes `FilingCodes.ADDRESS_CHANGE_OT` -> includes `changeOfAddress`
RULE: in `saveFiling()`: if `this.filingId > 0` -> calls `LegalServices.updateFiling()`; else calls `LegalServices.createFiling()`

ORDER: `onClickSaveResume()` calls `this.saveFiling(true)`, then extracts `filingId` and saves to `this.filingId`, then if no error calls `onClickSaveResumeFinish()` which calls `this.goToDashboard(true)`; error in `saveFiling()` sets `this.saveErrorReason` before catching, leaving `this.savedFiling` populated from error response
ORDER: `onClickFilePay()` calls `this.saveFiling(false)`, then extracts `filingId` and saves to `this.filingId`, then if no payment/save error calls `onClickFilePayFinish()` which may navigate to payment URL or dashboard; 402 error sets `this.haveChanges = false` and `this.paymentErrorDialog = true` before returning
ORDER: `saveFiling()` checks pending tasks first for new filings (before any save attempt), then builds filing object, then calls create/update API; save errors/warnings extracted from error response and stored before re-throwing

ON ERROR: in `onClickSaveResume()`: `this.saveFiling(true).catch()` - catches all errors, sets `this.saveErrorReason = SaveErrorReasons.SAVE_RESUME`, returns filing from error response or null, swallowed (not re-raised)
ON ERROR: in `onClickFilePay()`: `this.saveFiling(false).catch()` - catches all errors; if status `StatusCodes.PAYMENT_REQUIRED` (402) -> sets `this.haveChanges = false`, sets `this.paymentErrorDialog = true`, returns filing; else sets `this.saveErrorReason = SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY`, returns filing or null, swallowed (not re-raised)
ON ERROR: in `saveFiling()`: `LegalServices.hasPendingTasks().catch()` - catches error, sets `this.saveErrors = [{ error: 'Unable to check server for pending tasks.' }]`, throws new Error()
ON ERROR: in `saveFiling()`: try/catch around API calls - catches error, assigns `this.saveErrors = error?.response?.data?.errors || []`, assigns `this.saveWarnings = error?.response?.data?.warnings || []`, re-raises

CALLS OUT: `LegalServices.hasPendingTasks(this.getIdentifier)` - target as written, no credential visible in chunk
CALLS OUT: `LegalServices.updateFiling(this.getIdentifier, filing, this.filingId, isDraft)` - target as written, no credential visible in chunk
CALLS OUT: `LegalServices.createFiling(this.getIdentifier, filing, isDraft)` - target as written, no credential visible in chunk
CALLS OUT: `navigate(payUrl)` - constructs payment URL: `this.getAuthWebUrl + 'makepayment/' + paymentToken + '/' + encodeURIComponent(returnUrl)` where `returnUrl = this.baseUrl + '?filing_id=' + this.filingId`
CALLS OUT: `this.navigateToBusinessDashboard(this.getIdentifier, this.filingId)` or `this.navigateToBusinessDashboard(this.getIdentifier)` - target as written, no credential visible in chunk

STATES: Sets `this.filingId` from `this.savedFiling?.header?.filingId` (coerced to number, or 0)
STATES: Sets `this.haveChanges = false` after successful save
STATES: Sets `this.saveErrorReason = SaveErrorReasons.SAVE_RESUME` or `SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY` on save error
STATES: Sets `this.paymentErrorDialog = true` on 402 error
STATES: Sets `this.saveErrors = []` and `this.saveWarnings = []` at start of `saveFiling()`; populated from `error?.response?.data?.errors` and `error?.response?.data?.warnings` on failure
STATES: Sets `this.saving = false`, `this.savingResuming = false`, `this.filingPaying = false` after workflow steps complete

ABSENT: No duplicate save guard across the three paths (only per-path `this.busySaving` check); `goToDashboard()` implements the guard but other methods do not call it
ABSENT: No retry logic on failed `LegalServices` calls; errors caught and swallowed (payment error shows dialog; other errors set reason for dialog to handle)
ABSENT: No validation of `this.savedFiling` structure before accessing `?.header?.filingId` or `?.header?.isPaymentActionRequired`
ABSENT: No check that `paymentToken` exists before constructing payment URL; assumes success case always has it

34652.text:
Displays and manages the Annual Report filing form, handling user interactions, data changes, and error dialogs for both BC corporations and cooperatives.

ENTRY: `onClickConfirmExit()` – no check in this chunk; opens confirmation dialog and routes to dashboard if user clicks Cancel.

ENTRY: `allowChange(type)` – no check in this chunk; returns boolean for whether selected AGM Date is >= earliest allowed date.

ENTRY: `hasAction(director, action)` – no check in this chunk; returns boolean for whether action exists in director.actions array.

ENTRY: `onPaymentErrorDialogExit()` – no check in this chunk; closes payment error dialog; if `isRoleStaff` is true, stays on Staff Payment dialog; otherwise navigates to dashboard.

ENTRY: `onSaveErrorDialogRetry()` – no check in this chunk; retries the operation that failed based on `saveErrorReason`.

ENTRY: `onSaveErrorDialogOkay()` – no check in this chunk; finishes the operation that failed based on `saveErrorReason`.

ENTRY: `@Watch('asOfDate')` – fires when `asOfDate` changes; skipped if `!this.dataLoaded`; fetches original office addresses and directors for new date (overwrites current data), skipped if `isVitestRunning` is true.

ENTRY: `@Watch('isCertified')` – fires when `isCertified` changes; sets `haveChanges = this.dataLoaded`.

ENTRY: `@Watch('certifiedBy')` – fires when `certifiedBy` changes; sets `haveChanges = this.dataLoaded`.

ENTRY: `@Watch('staffPaymentData')` – fires when `staffPaymentData` changes; applies Priority flag and Waive Fees flag to filing codes based on entity type.

RULE: `allowChange()` – if `type === 'coa'` and (`getLastAddressChangeDate` or `getLastAnnualReportDate` exists) → `earliestAllowedDate = latestYyyyMmDd(getLastAddressChangeDate, getLastAnnualReportDate)`; else if `type === 'coa'` → `earliestAllowedDate = dateToYyyyMmDd(getFoundingDate)`.

RULE: `allowChange()` – if `type === 'cod'` and (`getLastDirectorChangeDate` or `getLastAnnualReportDate` exists) → `earliestAllowedDate = latestYyyyMmDd(getLastDirectorChangeDate, getLastAnnualReportDate)`; else if `type === 'cod'` → `earliestAllowedDate = dateToYyyyMmDd(getFoundingDate)`.

RULE: `onPaymentErrorDialogExit()` – if `isRoleStaff === true` → sets `paymentErrorDialog = false` only; else → sets `paymentErrorDialog = false` and calls `goToDashboard(true)`.

RULE: `onSaveErrorDialogRetry()` – if `saveErrorReason === SaveErrorReasons.SAVE` → calls `onClickSave()`; if `saveErrorReason === SaveErrorReasons.SAVE_RESUME` → calls `onClickSaveResume()`; if `saveErrorReason === SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY` and `isRoleStaff === true` → calls `onClickFilePay(true)`, else calls `onClickFilePay()`.

RULE: `onSaveErrorDialogOkay()` – if `saveErrorReason === SaveErrorReasons.SAVE` → calls `onClickSaveFinish()`; if `saveErrorReason === SaveErrorReasons.SAVE_RESUME` → calls `onClickSaveResumeFinish()`; if `saveErrorReason === SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY` → calls `onClickFilePayFinish()`.

RULE: `@Watch('staffPaymentData')` – if `isBaseCompany === true` → calls `updateFilingData('add', FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_BC, val.isPriority, waiveFees)`; else if `isEntityCoop === true` → calls `updateFilingData('add', FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_OT, val.isPriority, waiveFees)`.

RULE: `@Watch('staffPaymentData')` – if `waiveFees === true` → calls `updateFilingData('add', undefined, undefined, true)`; else → calls `updateFilingData('remove', undefined, undefined, true)`.

STATES: `paymentErrorDialog` set to false; `saveErrorReason` set to null; `haveChanges` set to false or `this.dataLoaded`; `isFetching` set to true then false.

CALLS OUT: `this.$refs.confirm.open()` with title 'Unsaved Changes', message about unsaved Annual Report changes, buttons: yes='Return to my filing', no=null, cancel='Exit without saving'.

CALLS OUT: `this.navigateToBusinessDashboard(this.getIdentifier)`.

CALLS OUT: `this.goToDashboard(true)`.

CALLS OUT: `this.$refs.officeAddressesComponent.getOrigAddresses(this.asOfDate, true)`.

CALLS OUT: `this.$refs.directorsComponent.getOrigDirectors(this.asOfDate, true)`.

CALLS OUT: `this.updateFilingData()` with various parameters: action ('add' or 'remove'), filing code (FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_BC, FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_OT, or undefined), priority flag, waive fees flag.

ABSENT: no error handling shown for async operations in watchers; no retry logic; no credential/token details for external calls.

34661.text:
# Continuation Out Filing Form Template

Vue template for a business filing UI that captures jurisdiction, business name, delivery contacts, certification, and court order details before submission and payment.

**ENTRY:** `onClickSave()` - called by Save button, no check in this chunk; `onClickSaveResume()` - called by Save and Resume Later button, no check in this chunk; `onClickFilePay()` - called by File and Pay button, no check in this chunk; `goToDashboard(exit)` - called by Cancel button and ResumeErrorDialog exit, no check in this chunk.

**RULE:** if `showLoadingContainer` is true -> loading spinner with `loadingMessage` displays; if `dataLoaded` is false -> main form hidden; if `showErrors` is true -> invalid-section and invalid-component classes applied to EffectiveDate, ForeignJurisdiction, BusinessNameForeign sections; if `!effectiveDateValid && showErrors` -> Effective Date section marked invalid; if `!foreignJurisdictionValid && showErrors` -> Jurisdiction Information section marked invalid; if `!businessNameValid && showErrors` -> Business Information section marked invalid; if `!documentDeliveryValid && showErrors` -> Documents Delivery section marked invalid; if `!certifyFormValid && showErrors` -> Certify section marked invalid; if `!courtOrderValid && showErrors` -> Court Order section marked invalid; if `isPayRequired` is true -> button text "File and Pay", else "File Now (no fee)"; if `isRoleStaff` is true -> DocumentDelivery editableCompletingParty enabled.
